name: Species, Ancestry, and Upbringing Inheritance
description: Species and Ancestries represent inherited traits; Upbringings represent learned traditions. Their parentage is independent, and biological ancestry does not by itself restrict Upbringing selection.

speciesInheritance.selection: Selecting a terminal Ancestry resolves its ancestor chain without requiring the user to select each ancestor.
speciesInheritance.filesystem: Directories may mirror the hierarchy but stable parent IDs are authoritative.

defaultSelectionOrder: Use an explicitly selected Upbringing instead of an ancestry default.
Otherwise use the selected Ancestry defaultUpbringing, when present.
Otherwise traverse the selected Ancestry parent chain to the nearest ancestor with defaultUpbringing.
If no default exists, leave selection unresolved instead of inventing an Upbringing.
upbringings.inheritance: The selected Upbringing inherits the benefits of its own parent chain; ancestors are not additional selections.
upbringings.association: A default is a reference on Species/Ancestry JSON, not a reverse defaultFor list on Upbringing records.

reviewNotes: Half-Elf and Half-Orc are reserved for the future Mixed Species mechanic, not initial Species.
The native C# character projector does not yet execute ancestry inheritance/default selections.
